assumptions.statement_zh: 组织方尚未提供可用于本节点的官方总体范围、重点区 polygon 和统一坐标资料；现有几何为 provisional，只用于概念表达和包内复算，官方资料到位后整包重算。
assumptions.statement_en: Official overall and key-area geometry is not available for this node; current geometry is provisional and must be replaced and recomputed.

assumptions.statement_zh: 车站遗存文保本体、保护范围、建设控制地带、产权和道路/市政控制条件未知；本方案不作法定、工程、容积率或高度结论。
assumptions.statement_en: Heritage controls, ownership and road/utility conditions are unknown; this package makes no statutory, engineering, FAR or height conclusion.

assumptions.statement_zh: 客流、文化消费、口述、活动和环境数据均为概念流程输入；不代表官方统计，不包含真实个体信息。
assumptions.statement_en: Visitor, cultural, oral-history, event and environmental data are concept-process inputs only, not official statistics or real personal data.

assumptions.statement_zh: 三处节点、三区两翼回路、可逆组件和阶段门均为原创概念建议，不能视为建设、合作或运营承诺。
assumptions.statement_en: Nodes, districts/wings, reversible components and gates are original concepts, not construction, cooperation or operating commitments.

assumptions.statement_zh: AI 场景仅允许匿名聚合、合成或公开输入；关键决策人工复核，禁止面部/声纹/精确轨迹、个体识别、安防筛查和自动审批。
assumptions.statement_en: AI scenarios use aggregate, synthetic or public inputs only; key decisions are human-reviewed and face, voice, precise tracking, screening and automated approval are prohibited.

assumptions.statement_zh: 口述或反馈只有在明示用途、可选署名、默认不公开、保留期限、撤回删除和申诉字段完整时才可进入后续试验；不同意不影响公共空间访问。
assumptions.statement_en: Oral or feedback content may proceed only with purpose, optional attribution, default non-publication, retention, withdrawal/deletion and appeal fields; refusal does not affect public access.

assumptions.statement_zh: 车站记忆开放日、京张口述史市集与轨影低刺激季均为建议性活动品牌，需现场安全、噪声、权利和主体核验，不代表政府安排或投资承诺。
assumptions.statement_en: The three activity brands are suggestions requiring site safety, sound, rights and actor review; they are not government or investment commitments.

assumptions.statement_zh: 八个全球 AI 生态入口中六个已完成官方/机构原始页面核验，两个仍为待核验队列；无论已核验与否都不引用绩效、合作、资金、排名或机构背书。
assumptions.statement_en: Six of the eight global AI ecology entries have a primary institutional page review; two remain verification queues. No performance, partnership, funding, ranking or endorsement claim is made for any entry.

assumptions.statement_zh: 连续无障碍、坡度、高差、障碍、噪声、照明、疏散和厕所等现状均需现场调查；概念图不构成全场地合规证明。
assumptions.statement_en: Accessible continuity, obstacles, sound, light, egress and toilets require site survey; concept drawings are not whole-site compliance proof.

assumptions.statement_zh: COMMUNITY-DISPLAY-ONLY 仅支持按征集规则展示，不自动授予商业、商标、训练、再许可或派生权；任何深化前重做权利核验。
assumptions.statement_en: COMMUNITY-DISPLAY-ONLY supports display under call rules only; commercial, trademark, training, relicensing and derivative rights require fresh clearance.
